steps.command:
sbx run <<'EOF'
pwd
ls -la /workspace
which openssl python3
openssl version
python3 --version
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
set -e
umask 077
mkdir -p /app/ssl
cd /app/ssl
rm -f server.key server.crt server.pem verification.txt

openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:2048 -sha256 -days 365 -nodes \
  -keyout server.key -out server.crt \
  -subj "/O=DevOps Team/CN=dev-internal.company.local" \
  -addext "subjectAltName=DNS:dev-internal.company.local"

chmod 600 server.key
chmod 644 server.crt

cat server.key server.crt > server.pem
chmod 600 server.pem

{
  echo "Subject: $(openssl x509 -in server.crt -noout -subject | sed 's/^subject=//')"
  echo "Not Before: $(openssl x509 -in server.crt -noout -startdate | sed 's/^notBefore=//')"
  echo "Not After: $(openssl x509 -in server.crt -noout -enddate | sed 's/^notAfter=//')"
  echo "Validity: $(openssl x509 -in server.crt -noout -dates | tr '\n' ' ' | sed 's/^notBefore=//; s/notAfter=/| /')"
  echo "SHA256 Fingerprint: $(openssl x509 -in server.crt -noout -fingerprint -sha256 | sed 's/^sha256 Fingerprint=//;s/^SHA256 Fingerprint=//')"
} > verification.txt
chmod 644 verification.txt

echo '--- files ---'
ls -l
echo '--- verification.txt ---'
cat verification.txt
echo '--- verify key matches cert ---'
[ "$(openssl x509 -in server.crt -noout -pubkey | openssl sha256)" = "$(openssl pkey -in server.key -pubout | openssl sha256)" ] && echo "key matches cert"
echo '--- cert check ---'
openssl x509 -in server.crt -noout -text | head -20
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
python3 - <<'PY'
import ssl, pprint
pprint.pprint(ssl._ssl._test_decode_cert('/app/ssl/server.crt'))
PY
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
cd /app/ssl
echo '--- openssl x509 on combined pem (key first) ---'
openssl x509 -in server.pem -noout -subject 2>&1
echo "exit=$?"
echo '--- openssl rsa on combined pem ---'
openssl rsa -in server.pem -noout -check 2>&1 | head -3
echo "exit=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
echo '--- verify self-signed ---'
openssl verify -CAfile server.crt server.crt
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
set -e
cd /app/ssl
not_before_iso=$(openssl x509 -in server.crt -noout -startdate | sed 's/^notBefore=//' | xargs -I{} date -u -d '{}' +%Y-%m-%d)
not_after_iso=$(openssl x509 -in server.crt -noout -enddate | sed 's/^notAfter=//' | xargs -I{} date -u -d '{}' +%Y-%m-%d)
{
  echo "Subject: $(openssl x509 -in server.crt -noout -subject | sed 's/^subject=//')"
  echo "Issuer: $(openssl x509 -in server.crt -noout -issuer | sed 's/^issuer=//')"
  echo "Not Before: $(openssl x509 -in server.crt -noout -startdate | sed 's/^notBefore=//')"
  echo "Not After: $(openssl x509 -in server.crt -noout -enddate | sed 's/^notAfter=//')"
  echo "Valid From: $not_before_iso"
  echo "Valid Until: $not_after_iso"
  echo "SHA-256 Fingerprint: $(openssl x509 -in server.crt -noout -fingerprint -sha256 | sed 's/^[^=]*=//')"
} > verification.txt
chmod 644 verification.txt
cat verification.txt
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
set -e
cd /app
python3 check_cert.py
echo '---'
stat -c '%a %n' /app/ssl/server.key /app/ssl/server.crt /app/ssl/server.pem /app/ssl/verification.txt /app/check_cert.py
openssl rsa -in /app/ssl/server.key -noout -check
openssl x509 -in /app/ssl/server.crt -noout -subject -enddate -fingerprint -sha256
EOF
